name: Murakoshi Shinta
source:
A man who moves into the apartment building where the protagonist lives.

He becomes acquainted with the protagonist by chance, and for some reason, they become very close.

He teaches the protagonist, who is seeking change, the art of hypnosis, but...

Aside from being a young medical school professor, there is much about him that is mysterious.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.blackrainbow.jp/br/jutsu2/chara07.html]the official site[/url]]
